methods.label: Evaluate the floor before substituting
methods.explanation:
Here \(y=-\frac25\ne0\), so the definition applies. First calculate the quotient inside the floor:
\[
\frac{3/8}{-2/5}=\frac38\left(-\frac52\right)=-\frac{15}{16}.
\]
Since \(-1<-\frac{15}{16}<0\), the greatest integer at most this quotient is \(-1\). Substituting that value into the given rule gives
\[
\operatorname{rem}\left(\frac38,-\frac25\right)
=\frac38-\left(-\frac25\right)(-1)
=\frac38-\frac25
=\frac{15-16}{40}
=-\frac1{40}.
\]
The value is \(-\frac1{40}\), choice \(\mathrm{B}\).
